units.locator: Article 54. Length of civil service
units.text: 4) municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Length of civil service
units.text: 5) other positions in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Length of civil service
units.text: 2. In addition to periods of holding the positions specified in part 1 of this Article, other periods of holding positions on a list approved by the President of the Russian Federation shall be included (credited) in length of civil service for establishing a civil servant's monthly supplement to the position salary for length of civil service, determining the duration of additional annual paid leave for length of service and the amount of incentives for impeccable and effective civil service, in accordance with the procedure for calculating length of civil service established by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 54

units.locator: Article 54. Length of civil service
units.text: 3. Length of state civil service of the Russian Federation for granting civil servants a length-of-service pension shall be determined in accordance with the federal law on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have performed state service and their families.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 54

units.locator: Chapter 12. INCENTIVES AND AWARDS. SERVICE DISCIPLINE IN CIVIL SERVICE
units.text: Chapter 12. INCENTIVES AND AWARDS. SERVICE DISCIPLINE IN CIVIL SERVICE
units.label: Chapter 12. INCENTIVES AND AWARDS. SERVICE DISCIPLINE IN CIVIL SERVICE

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.label: Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 1. The following types of incentives and awards shall apply for impeccable and effective civil service:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 1) a declaration of gratitude with payment of a lump-sum incentive;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 2) award of a certificate of honour of the state body, with payment of a lump-sum incentive or presentation of a valuable gift;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 3) other types of incentives and awards of the state body;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 4) payment of a lump-sum incentive upon retirement on a state length-of-service pension;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 5) an incentive granted by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 6) an incentive granted by the President of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 7) award of state honours of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 8)–9) repealed. — Federal Law No. 288-ФЗ of 31.07.2020.
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 1.1. To encourage and reward civil servants of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation for impeccable and effective civil service, the constituent entity's laws may provide for incentives granted by its highest official and for the award of honours of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 2. A decision to grant an incentive or award to a civil servant in accordance with points 1–4 of part 1 of this Article shall be made by the employer's representative; a decision to grant an incentive or award in accordance with points 5–7 of part 1 of this Article shall be made on the proposal of the employer's representative under the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 3. A civil servant shall be paid the lump-sum incentive provided for in points 1–3 of part 1 of this Article under the procedure and at the rates approved by the employer's representative within the established civil servants' payroll fund.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 4. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 288-ФЗ of 31.07.2020.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 5. Decisions on incentives or awards under points 1–4 of part 1 of this Article shall be formalized by a legal act of the state body, and those under points 5–7 of part 1 of this Article by legal acts of the Russian Federation. The corresponding record of the incentive or award shall be entered in the civil servant's employment record book (where available) and personal file.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 5.1. Civil servants, and citizens dismissed from civil service after being nominated for an award or incentive in accordance with part 2 of this Article, shall, upon receiving state honours of the Russian Federation or an incentive from the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, be paid a lump-sum incentive from the civil servants' payroll fund.
units.label: Part 5.1 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 5.2. In the event of the death of a civil servant or of a citizen specified in part 5.1 of this Article who has received a state honour of the Russian Federation or an incentive from the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, and in the event of a posthumous state honour of the Russian Federation, the lump-sum incentive shall be paid to the civil servant's or citizen's family members. In such cases, the lump-sum incentive shall be paid no later than one month after expiry of the six-month period during which family members of the deceased civil servant or citizen may apply for that payment to the state body in which the person held a position. That period shall run from the date of issue of the legal act of the Russian Federation awarding the honour or incentive to the civil servant or citizen. If several family members apply for the lump-sum incentive not received by the civil servant or citizen owing to death, the amount shall be divided equally among the family members.
units.label: Part 5.2 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 5.3. The following shall be considered family members entitled to the lump-sum incentive provided for in parts 5.1 and 5.2 of this Article:
units.label: Part 5.3 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 1) the wife (husband) who was married to the civil servant or the citizen dismissed from civil service on the day of their death;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5.3 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 2) the parents of the civil servant or citizen dismissed from civil service;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5.3 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 3) the children of the civil servant or citizen dismissed from civil service;
units.label: Point 3 Part 5.3 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 4) persons who were dependent on the deceased civil servant or deceased citizen dismissed from civil service.
units.label: Point 4 Part 5.3 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 5.4. The rates and procedure for paying the lump-sum incentive to federal civil servants, citizens dismissed from federal civil service and their family members in the cases provided for in parts 5.1 and 5.2 of this Article shall be established by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5.4 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 55. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 6. Laws and other regulatory legal acts of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall establish the rates, procedure and conditions for paying a lump-sum incentive to civil servants of that constituent entity and citizens dismissed from its civil service after nomination for an award or incentive, taking into account the provisions of this Article.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 55

units.locator: Article 56. Service discipline in civil service
units.text: Article 56. Service discipline in civil service
units.label: Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Service discipline in civil service
units.text: 1. Service discipline in civil service means civil servants' mandatory compliance with the internal service rules of the state body and official duties regulations established in accordance with this Federal Law, other federal laws, other regulatory legal acts, regulatory acts of the state body and the service contract.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Service discipline in civil service
units.text: 2. In accordance with this Federal Law, other federal laws, other regulatory legal acts on civil service, regulatory acts of the state body and the service contract, the employer's representative shall create the conditions necessary for civil servants to observe service discipline.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Service discipline in civil service
units.text: 3. The internal service rules of a state body shall be determined by a regulatory act of that body governing the service (work) schedule and rest time.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 56. Service discipline in civil service
units.text: 4. The internal service rules of the state body shall be approved by the employer's representative, taking into account the opinion of that state body's elected trade union body.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 56

units.locator: Article 57. Disciplinary sanctions
units.text: Article 57. Disciplinary sanctions
units.label: Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Disciplinary sanctions
units.text: 1. For a disciplinary offence, namely culpable non-performance or improper performance by a civil servant of the service duties assigned to them, the employer's representative may impose the following disciplinary sanctions:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Disciplinary sanctions
units.text: 1) an admonition;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Disciplinary sanctions
units.text: 2) a reprimand;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Disciplinary sanctions
units.text: 3) a warning of incomplete suitability for the position;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Disciplinary sanctions
units.text: 4) repealed. — Federal Law No. 116-ФЗ of 07.06.2013;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Disciplinary sanctions
units.text: 5) dismissal from civil service on the grounds established by point 2, subpoints ‘а’–‘г’ of point 3, and points 5 and 6 of part 1 of Article 37 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 57. Disciplinary sanctions
units.text: 2. Only one disciplinary sanction may be imposed for each disciplinary offence.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 57

units.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.label: Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 1. Before imposing a disciplinary sanction, the employer's representative must request a written explanation from the civil servant. If the civil servant refuses to provide such an explanation, a corresponding statement shall be drawn up. A civil servant's refusal to provide a written explanation shall not prevent imposition of a disciplinary sanction.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 2. An internal service inquiry shall be conducted before a disciplinary sanction is imposed.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 3. When imposing a disciplinary sanction, the seriousness of the civil servant's disciplinary offence, degree of fault, the circumstances in which it was committed and the civil servant's previous performance of official duties shall be taken into account.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 4. A disciplinary sanction shall be imposed promptly after discovery of the disciplinary offence, but no later than one month from its discovery, excluding periods of the civil servant's temporary incapacity for work, leave, other absence from service for valid reasons, and the time taken by the internal service inquiry.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 5. A disciplinary sanction may not be imposed later than six months after the disciplinary offence was committed, or, following an inspection of financial and economic activities or an audit, later than two years after it was committed. Time spent on criminal proceedings shall not be included in those periods.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 6. A copy of the act imposing a disciplinary sanction on a civil servant, stating the grounds for its imposition, shall be delivered to the civil servant against signature within five days after the relevant act is issued.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 7. A civil servant may appeal against a disciplinary sanction in writing to the state body's service disputes commission or to a court.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 8. If, within one year from imposition of a disciplinary sanction provided for in points 1–3 of part 1 of Article 57 of this Federal Law and a sanction provided for in Article 59.1 of this Federal Law, a civil servant is not subjected to a new disciplinary sanction, they shall be deemed to have no disciplinary sanction.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 9. The employer's representative may lift a civil servant's disciplinary sanction before one year has elapsed from its imposition, on their own initiative, on the civil servant's written application or on a request from the civil servant's immediate supervisor.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 58. Procedure for imposing and lifting a disciplinary sanction
units.text: 10. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 116-ФЗ of 07.06.2013.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 58

units.locator: Article 59. Internal service inquiry
units.text: Article 59. Internal service inquiry
units.label: Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 1. An internal service inquiry shall be conducted by decision of the employer's representative or on a civil servant's written application.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 2. An internal service inquiry must establish fully, objectively and comprehensively:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 1) whether the civil servant committed a disciplinary offence;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 2) the civil servant's fault;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 3) the causes and conditions that contributed to the civil servant's disciplinary offence;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 4) the nature and extent of the harm caused by the civil servant as a result of the disciplinary offence;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 5) the circumstances forming the grounds for the civil servant's written application for an internal service inquiry.
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 3. The employer's representative who ordered the internal service inquiry shall monitor its timeliness and proper conduct.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 4. The internal service inquiry shall be entrusted to the state body's state service and personnel unit, with participation of its legal unit and elected trade union body.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 59

units.locator: Article 59. Internal service inquiry
units.text: 5. A civil servant with a direct or indirect interest in the outcome of an internal service inquiry may not participate in it. In such cases, they shall submit a written application to the employer's representative who ordered the inquiry, requesting release from participation. If this requirement is not met, the results of the internal service inquiry shall be considered invalid.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 59
